vo.vo: Your suppliers don't agree on anything.
Every supplier wants purchase orders a different way.
ProcuLink is the one bridge between all of them.

beats.vo: It starts at upload — CSV, Excel, PDF, or EDI formats like EDIFACT and X12. ProcuLink detects the format, the PO number, and the lines.
Each upload routes to one supplier — their format, their channel, their codes.
Then upload: parse, normalize, validate — and into review.
Review is where an order becomes supplier-ready. The fix queue holds only the lines that need a decision.
The AI suggests the supplier's code, with a confidence score and the reason. If it's right — accept, and the queue moves on.
Or type the code yourself — ProcuLink remembers it for next time.
The readiness card is the honest pre-send check — lines, acceptance rules, conformance, delivery.
When everything is green, send. One confirmation — the exact format this supplier requires.
Generating. Sent. Delivered. Every step lands in the audit trail — proof for every order.
Load the supplier's own catalog so suggestions only use real codes — import a file, pull on a schedule, or take an HTTP push.
Every integration is a versioned connection: changes happen in drafts, and tests replay your own recent orders.
Publishing is explicit — in-flight orders keep their revision — and rollback is one click away.
Nothing fails silently. Exceptions explain problems in plain language; system health shows the pipeline at a glance — requeue included.
And every screen explains itself — its guide is behind the help button.
ProcuLink. The missing link between buyers and suppliers. Start free — with a sample order — today.
